Card text of Reverend Blackwood (Tremere Antitribu) says:
Rev Blackwood inflicts +1 damage on strike cards requiring thaumaturgy.

Iplay blood fury. I inflict 3 unpreventable damage to the opposing
minion, +1 "bonus" damage . Is this +1 unprevantable ?

I play Walk of flames at short range. So I inflict 2aggravated + 1
normal damage ? or 3 aggravated damage ?

I play Walk of flames at long range. I inflict 2 R aggravated, but whata
about the +1 ? nothing says it's ranged...

I play Theft of Vitae at short range. So I steal 2 blood and inflict 1
damage, or steal 3 blood ? What about long range ?

The same for Soul burn : Do I inflinct 2R unpreventable or 3R
unpreventable, or 2R unp +1 normal damage ?

By the way, playing with tremeres, I often play Blood Rage. If this
strike is dodged, is the side effect uneffective -i mean can opposing
minion dodge then use a weapon for additional damage ?

thanks for your patience
reyda

Messages.Author: Passenger Pigeon
Messages.Body:
In article <39BE0D82...@club-internet.fr>, reyda seddiki
<re...@club-internet.fr> wrote:

> Card text of Reverend Blackwood (Tremere Antitribu) says:
> Rev Blackwood inflicts +1 damage on strike cards requiring thaumaturgy.
>
> Iplay blood fury. I inflict 3 unpreventable damage to the opposing
> minion, +1 "bonus" damage . Is this +1 unprevantable ?

Yes.

> I play Walk of flames at short range. So I inflict 2aggravated + 1
> normal damage ? or 3 aggravated damage ?

Aggravated.

> I play Walk of flames at long range. I inflict 2 R aggravated, but whata
> about the +1 ? nothing says it's ranged...

It is.

> I play Theft of Vitae at short range. So I steal 2 blood and inflict 1
> damage, or steal 3 blood ? What about long range ?

No.

Blackwood's card text is unclear; pretend it says "any tha strikes that
do damage do an additional damage." Thus, Theft of Vitae, which does no
damage, does not get a +1 damage. You steal 2 blood. In the same way,
Blackwood's special ability increases the damage that Walk of Flame
does, so the "extra" damage is automatically ranged.

> The same for Soul burn : Do I inflinct 2R unpreventable or 3R
> unpreventable, or 2R unp +1 normal damage ?

3R unpreventable.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
reyda seddiki <re...@club-internet.fr> wrote:
> Card text of Reverend Blackwood (Tremere Antitribu) says:
> Rev Blackwood inflicts +1 damage on strike cards requiring
> thaumaturgy.

Some pertinent rulings from the web page:

Adding damage to strikes which are not damage dealing strikes
will not deal damage (e.g., using Lucky Blow and choosing your
Rowan Ring melee weapon won't deal damage) [RTR 21-FEB-1996]

Additional damage inherits all of the properties of the base
damage (So the +1 damage from lucky blow is aggravated for
Basilia). [RTR]

> Iplay blood fury. I inflict 3 unpreventable damage to the opposing
> minion, +1 "bonus" damage . Is this +1 unprevantable ?

It is preventable, just like the "base" damage from Blood Fury.
None of the damage can be prevented by cards that require Fortitude,
however.

> I play Walk of flames at short range. So I inflict 2aggravated + 1
> normal damage ? or 3 aggravated damage ?

3 (2+1) ranged aggravated damage. Being at close range doesn't
mean the damage is not still "ranged" damage.

> I play Walk of flames at long range. I inflict 2 R aggravated, but
whata
> about the +1 ? nothing says it's ranged...

You inflict 3 (2+1) ranged aggravated damage.

> I play Theft of Vitae at short range. So I steal 2 blood and inflict 1
> damage, or steal 3 blood ? What about long range ?

You steal two blood. The Reverend's ability doesn't affect
non-damage-dealing strikes.

> The same for Soul burn : Do I inflinct 2R unpreventable or 3R
> unpreventable, or 2R unp +1 normal damage ?

3 (2+1) ranged damage that cannot be prevented by cards that require
Fortitude.

> By the way, playing with tremeres, I often play Blood Rage. If this
> strike is dodged, is the side effect uneffective -i mean can opposing
> minion dodge then use a weapon for additional damage ?

Yes and yes. Dodge dodges the whoel strike (inasfar as it affects
the dodging minion and any non-Retainer cards on the dodger).
